evaluations.model_answer: For the Semitic language family, two of the six model configurations show a negative effect value: mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂.

evaluations.question: Which language family has the smallest spread (range) across its six model configurations?
evaluations.expected_answer: Isolate or Uralic (both have very small bars close to 0, with a range of roughly 1-2)
evaluations.model_answer: The Uralic language family has the smallest spread (range) across its six model configurations, with all effect values clustered near zero (between approximately -1 and +1).

evaluations.question: In how many language families does XLM-B2 exceed or approximately equal an effect value of 15?
evaluations.model_answer: XLM-B2 (red bars) exceeds or approximately equals an effect value of 15 in 3 language families: IE-Germanic (~15), IE-Indic (~21), and Semitic (~20).
